Cardano [activated its Van Rossem hard fork](https://gov.tools/outcomes/governance_actions/fdd468da5cc4ac8431dcd7e2b3211666c73bc229f85879469f67f1d9d51d344d#0) on Saturday, moving the mainnet to protocol version 11. The technical changes lower smart contract costs and lay groundwork for an upcoming scalability overhaul. But a more consequential change is who directed the upgrade. For the first time in Cardano's history, it wasn't Input Output, the engineering firm that designed and built the blockchain.
